jobs.title: Environmental Health Specialist
jobs.description:
**About FACS**


At FACS, our mission is to make environments safer and healthier for the people who live and work in them. As one of the nation's leading environmental health consulting firms, we help organizations protect their people, assets, and communities. We are built on purpose, partnership, and performance—delivering measurable impact with every client engagement.

**Our Values**


We live our mission through three core values:

* **People First:** Support our team and clients, promote professional growth, and value collaboration.
* **Integrity of the Science:** Deliver accurate, reliable results through objective, evidence\-based practices.
* **Client Relationships for Life:** Build long\-term partnerships and help clients address environmental health challenges.

**About FACS \& You**


At FACS, your work contributes directly to safer, healthier communities. Ranked "Best Places to Work" for five consecutive years, we invest in your success through training, mentorship, and support for professional certifications—so you can grow, thrive, and build a career with lasting impact.

**Curious to see what we do?**

* FACS Experts – Meet our team and see who you’ll be working with.

**Why Join Us**

* **Impact:** Contribute meaningful work that empowers teams and drives results across the organization.
* **Culture:** Thrive in a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and mission\-driven environment where your work matters.
* **Growth:** Innovate, develop your skills, and help shape the future of how we operate and deliver on our mission.
* **Visibility:** Partner directly with leadership and cross\-functional teams to make a real difference.

**About the Role:**


The Environmental Health Specialist will support public health and well\-being by conducting field work and assessments for various environmental and industrial hygiene projects. You will leverage your ability to maintain client relationships, while building and maintaining strong technical and field experience. This is a fulfilling and challenging role for those who enjoy hands\-on work and making a positive impact in the health and safety of our communities. Our ideal candidate has strong attention to detail and punctuality, positive work ethic, enjoys rolling up their sleeves to get the job done, and are open to learning beyond their comfort zone.

**Responsibilities:**

* Carry out and execute field projects as assigned by Project Manager(s).
* Maintain regular communication with Project Manager(s) to exchange project updates and technical information; report progress and seek guidance as needed.
* Receive project information from Project Manager(s) and ensure full understanding of scope of work.
* Follow established protocols for data collection, sample collection, and documentation.
* Perform field data collection across a variety of projects to support analysis.
* Gather required tools and equipment for project work and consult Project Manager(s) when additional direction is needed.
* Prepare detailed field notes, compile data, and summarize findings.
* Maintain a professional and cooperative demeanor when interacting with clients, contractors, and other stakeholders at project sites.
* Actively participate in training and professional development opportunities to strengthen technical skills and knowledge in Industrial Hygiene practices.

**What You Bring:**

* High School diploma or equivalent is required. Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in environmental science or related field is a plus
* Strong written and verbal communication for data entry and reporting

**Physical \& Work Requirements**

* Physical ability to stoop, kneel, climb, crawl, and access a variety of different work environments to collect samples.
* Ability to lift and carry equipment and instruments weighing up to 50 lbs.
* Successfully complete annual physical examinations and OSHA\-required respirator fit testing.
* Flexibility to work outside of standard business hours, including evenings, nights, and weekends, as project demands require.
* Travel to client sites and other work locations as needed.
* Prolonged periods of sitting while using a computer to complete documentation and reports.
* Must successfully pass a background check.

**Compensation and Rewards**

* Competitive base salary with performance\-based bonus structure tied to individual and team achievements
* Comprehensive benefits package, including:
	+ Medical coverage with 100% company\-paid premiums for employees and their families, plus 50% of the annual deductible covered by the company
	+ 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions
	+ Vision and dental plan options
	+ Flexible Spending Accounts (health care and dependent care)
	+ Company\-sponsored programs including Employee Assistance Program, life and disability insurance, Rocket Lawyer legal services, and mobile phone plan with Verizon
	+ Voluntary benefits options including supplemental life insurance for employees and dependents, short\-term disability, hospital, accident, and pet insurance
	+ Generous PTO (3 weeks accrual), paid holidays, volunteer days, and floating holiday
	+ Tuition Reimbursement Program to promote higher education
	+ Paid training and certifications to support career advancement
	+ Incentive Bonus Plan and Donation Matching Program

**Wage Transparency**


Pay for this position is based on a number of factors including geographic location, relevant knowledge, skills, and experience.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**


Forensic Analytical Consulting Services is an equal\-opportunity employer that complies with EEOC rules and regulations. We are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion and do not discriminate based on race, age, disability, or other non\-merit characteristics. We welcome all candidates to apply, including women, people of color, persons with disabilities, and veterans.

jobs.title: Environmental Scientist/Contaminated Land (FIFO) - Northern Territory
jobs.description:
* Major Metals Refinery Closure
* 12\-month full time, site\-based project (extension possible)
* FIFO (2:1\) from any Australian location to Nhulunbuy, Northern Territory

 **About the Project**

  

Tetra Tech Coffey is delivering environmental and contaminated land services to support a major metals refinery closure in Northern Territory, a major component of a broader decommissioning program.  

  

Works involve remediation tracking, contaminated materials management, validation of remediation scopes, and compliance oversight in a complex remote industrial environment

 **The Role**

  

We are seeking an experienced (2 to 5 years) Contaminated Land Consultant (field‑based) to provide on\-site soil validation advice and support, sampling supervision, and contaminated materials support during remediation earthworks.  

  

You will work daily alongside the client, providing practical, technically defensible environmental advice to support the remediation objectives and maintain compliance with the Remediation Action Plan.

 **Key Responsibilities**

**Field Delivery**

* Collect soil and surface water samples, to complete contaminated soil and surface water assessments, delineation, and validation sampling.
* Manage and maintain health and safety on a large remediation project with significant heavy plant movements.
* Provide field\-based material advice to the remediation contractor.
* Oversee material tracking and compliance with the remediation action plan and the remediation validation plan.
* Manage unexpected finds and provide advice to the remediation contractor.
* Maintain strong QA/QC and field records.
* Undertake field pH testing
* Work collaboratively with site teams, technical and project management teams based offsite.

 **Contractor Interface**

* Act as the primary site contact for client requests and advice and manage technical delivery of requests in collaboration with the subject matter expert.
* Support daily pre‑starts and toolbox talks.
* Attend regular client meetings.
* Balance production needs with environmental compliance.

 **Reporting \& Compliance**

* Prepare field summaries and contribute to validation reporting.
* Prepare material classification and other technical memorandums, based on ongoing site requirements.
* Maintain chain‑of‑custody and coordinate laboratories.
* Support EMP, HSE, and regulatory compliance obligations.

  

  

**About You**  

  

**You'll have:**

* You'll be a qualified Environmental Scientist with 2\-5 years experience in contaminated land consulting.
* Demonstrated experience conducting soil and surface water samples, assessments, delineation, and validation sampling on brownfield/industrial sites.
* Experience supporting civil earthworks.
* Strong documentation and communication skills.
* Current, unrestricted Australian Drivers License.
* Ability to meet company \& project medical requirements.
* Confident working independently in remote FIFO settings.

 **Highly Regarded:**

* NT regulatory knowledge.
* Large‑scale remediation or decommissioning experience.
* FIFO or remote project experience.

 **What We Offer**

* Highly competitive salary; provision of mobilisation costs including flights, camp accommodation and meals.
* 2:1 roster (or 2:2 / 3:1 depending on candidate).
* Opportunity to contribute to one of the Southern Hemisphere’s most significant industrial closure and remediation projects.
* Long\-duration project exposure within a technically complex heavy industrial environment.
* Support from an experienced, highly credentialled Environmental Scientists.

  


**About us**  

  

Tetra Tech Coffey provides high\-end environmental, geotechnical, digital, and engineering design consulting services in Australia, New Zealand and Papua New Guinea. Every day, our people come together to solve complex challenges for our clients.

  

With over 30,000 Tetra Tech colleagues across 550 offices globally, we deliver projects that improve lives through science, technology, and innovation.  

  

Our commitment to creating lasting, measurable value is reflected in our global 1 Billion People Challenge, which tracks how our 100,000\+ annual projects benefit people and communities around the world.


Additional Information
* Organization: 754 COF

jobs.title: Senior Hazardous Materials Consultant
jobs.description:
* Role with genuine project ownership \& technical responsibility
* Company Vehicle, competitive salary, overtime
* Strong career development with the backing of global Kiwa group


  

Kiwa ELS is a customer\-focused, results\-driven risk management consultancy with offices in Brisbane and Sydney. We deliver hazardous materials, occupational hygiene, environmental and risk management consulting services to clients across Australia.  

  

As part of the Kiwa Group—a global leader in testing, inspection and certification with more than 12,000 professionals across 35\+ countries—we offer the backing of an international organisation while maintaining a strong local presence.  

  

Working alongside our NATA\-accredited laboratory, our Hazardous Materials team provides asbestos, mould and hazardous materials management, assessment and advisory services to an established client base across the construction, facilities management, transport, insurance and government sectors.  

  

Due to continued growth, we are seeking a full\-time Senior Hazardous Materials Consultant to join our Brisbane\-based team.  

  

Approximately 60% of your time will be spent on site across Southeast Queensland, undertaking hazardous materials and occupational hygiene work. The remaining 40% will be office\-based and focused on technical reporting, project management, proposals, quality assurance and supporting the development of other consultants. Occasional travel to regional locations and interstate may also be required.  

  

**What you will be doing**  

* Conduct asbestos, mould and hazardous materials surveys across industrial, commercial and residential properties.
* Undertake clearance inspections and airborne asbestos fibre monitoring associated with asbestos removal work.
* Complete contamination and post\-remediation verification assessments for asbestos, mould, moisture and other contaminants.
* Conduct occupational hygiene surveys and monitoring
* Manage projects, including developing scopes of work, preparing fee proposals, coordinating resources and ensuring project objectives and deadlines are achieved.
* Produce clear, accurate hazardous materials and occupational hygiene reports.
* Undertake technical review and quality assurance of reports prepared by other consultants.
* Provide technical guidance, training and mentoring to less experienced consultants.
* Liaise with clients and stakeholders to understand project requirements and provide practical technical advice.
* Perform laboratory analysis, including fibre counting for airborne asbestos, where required.
* Conduct respirator face fit testing when required.
* Ensure client deliverables are completed accurately and within agreed timeframes.
* Quality Assurance support when required

**Why work with us?**  

* Company vehicle provided.
* Competitive salary \& overtime based on your experience.
* Senior position with genuine project ownership and technical responsibility.
* Opportunity to mentor and support the development of other consultants.
* Ongoing training and career development opportunities.
* Kiwa Rewards, including discounts on shopping, travel, insurance and more.
* Access to our Employee Assistance Program.
* Supportive local team with the backing of a global organisation.


  

**Experience and qualifications**  

* 3\+ years’ experience in hazardous materials consulting, occupational hygiene or a closely related field.
* A current LAA licence is essential.
* A current Australian driver’s licence is essential.
* Science, environmental or hazardous materials qualifications, including relevant P\-Certs, are desirable.
* Professional membership with AIOH, FAMANZ or a similar industry body will be highly regarded.
* Demonstrated experience preparing and reviewing technical reports.
* Experience managing projects, developing scopes and preparing fee proposals will be highly regarded.

**About you**  

* Strong asbestos and/or Occ Hygiene background \- Technically strong and confident providing advice to clients, contractors and other consultants.
* Comfortable balancing hands\-on fieldwork with reporting, project management and technical review.
* Well organised and capable of managing multiple projects, priorities and deadlines.
* Able to communicate clearly and professionally with a broad range of stakeholders.
* Confident mentoring and providing constructive technical feedback to other consultants.
* Practical, safety\-focused and detail\-oriented.
* Able to work independently while contributing positively to the wider team.

If you are an experienced hazardous materials professional looking for a senior role that combines fieldwork, project ownership and technical leadership, apply now to join the Kiwa ELS team.
